question: When two people look at the same emoji in a message, how often do they read the same feeling into it?
answer: Less often than senders assume. A 2016 study asked people to rate common face emoji and found frequent disagreement over whether one was positive or negative, even when everyone saw the identical image. Across phones it was worse: the same grinning face looked joyful on some systems and like a grimace on Apple's.
move: A symbol carries the meaning its reader brings, not the one sent.
ask: When did a short message of mine land with a feeling I never meant to send?
reference: Miller, Thebault-Spieker, Chang, Johnson, Terveen & Hecht, Blissfully Happy or Ready to Fight: Varying Interpretations of Emoji, ICWSM, 2016
